summary: Examples of product with two lists, with repeat, and combined with map('join') to build domain names.
questions: How do I append .com to a list of names using product?
What's an example of the product filter?

answer_card.title: product examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
product: "{{ [1,2,3,4,5] | product(['a', 'b', 'c']) }}"
# => [[1,'a'],[1,'b'],[1,'c'],[2,'a'],...]

repeat_original: "{{ [1,2] | product(repeat=2) }}"
# => [[1,1],[1,2],[2,1],[2,2]]

domains: "{{ ['example', 'ansible', 'redhat'] | product(['com']) | map('join', '.') }}"
# => ['example.com', 'ansible.com', 'redhat.com']
```
